title_en: That’s a Wrap… See you in 2027!
title_zh: 年终收官…2027 年见！Jon Caplis 的年度回顾
subtitle_zh: The Derivative 主持人独白收官：回顾 2026 年市场与精彩对谈，团队休整，2027 年再见。
summary_zh: 本期是 RCM Alternatives 旗下 The Derivative 的年终收官短集，由主持人 Jon Caplis 独自出镜、没有嘉宾。他先感谢听众一年的陪伴，随后回顾 2026 年的市场与节目：年初大宗商品（commodities）的躁动、金属暴跌、战争与霍尔木兹海峡（Strait of Hormuz）推高油价的呼声，以及 Substack 上一篇唱衰 AI 的文章真正撼动了市场。他还盘点了几期心头好，包括 OpenSnow 的 Joel Gratz、趋势跟踪（trend following）传奇 Pat Welton、聊收益叠加（return stacking）与可迁移阿尔法（portable alpha）的 Corey Hoffstein、Adam Butler、大宗商品交易员 Josh Blanchfield、谈铀与核能的 Trevor Holland，以及讲国防科技（defense tech）与无人机的 Ian Weiner。最后他致谢赞助与制作团队，宣布从感恩节休整至一月回归，并预告新年全新嘉宾阵容。这期为听众提供了一份轻松的年度回顾与补听清单。
description: That’s a Wrap… See you in 2027!

turns.en: Welcome to the derivative by our Sam Alternatives, send it. Hello there. Welcome back to the derivative brought to you by our Sam Alternatives, where yes we still have that new website if you haven't checked it out yet, rcmalts.com. You caught me in casual mode today, notice the hoodie, notice the hat, because we're
turns.zh: 欢迎收听由 RCM Alternatives 带来的 The Derivative。大家好，欢迎回到由 RCM Alternatives 为您呈现的 The Derivative——没错，我们那个新网站还在，如果你还没看过，网址是 rcmalts.com。今天你撞见我是休闲模式，注意这件连帽衫，注意这顶帽子，因为我们……

turns.en: not bringing you any guests today, just me, as we're closing the books on another year, another great year of the pod as we shut things down for our usual Thanksgiving through New Year's break. I should really switch that to a January February break, so you know, right, during ski season and all.
turns.zh: ……今天不请任何嘉宾，就只有我一个人。因为我们正在为又一年画上句号——又是很棒的一季播客——接下来要照例从感恩节一直休到新年。我真该把这个假期改到一月、二月再休，你懂的，正好赶上滑雪季之类的。

turns.en: I still haven't cracked the code on me and the guests on the ski left, right? On chat, ski down, chat again on the lift, I think that would be a good format. Kind of like when Seinfeld did the comedians and cars getting coffee type thing, maybe I could call it quants on quads, hedgers hiking hills, anything, anyway, let's start with
turns.zh: 我一直没琢磨明白，能不能带着嘉宾一起上滑雪缆车（ski lift）——坐缆车上山聊天，滑下去，再坐缆车接着聊，我觉得这会是个不错的形式。有点像 Seinfeld 那个《Comedians in Cars Getting Coffee》的路子，也许我可以叫它“量化人坐缆车”（quants on quads）、“对冲客爬山”（hedgers hiking hills）什么的，随便啦。总之，先来个……

turns.en: the big thank you, thanks to all of you for tuning in and listening this year, whether you've been with us since day one, or you just asked some AI chatbot what portable alpha is and it's bitchy out here, we appreciate you listening. We all know your time is precious and that you carve out an hour or so a week to listen
turns.zh: ……大大的感谢。谢谢你们这一年一直收听我们，无论你是从第一天就跟着，还是刚问了某个 AI 聊天机器人什么是可迁移阿尔法（portable alpha）——外头的行情可不好混——我们都很感激你来听。我们都知道你的时间宝贵，你每周都专门挤出一个小时左右来听……

turns.en: to us on the show, talk catch one talk is special. Again, thank you, just don't tell me at a conference that you listened me at the gym. That was a little weird. Freak me out a little bit. So it was a wild year. We had commodities going, little nuts to start the year, then the metals melt down.
turns.zh: ……我们在节目上聊的东西。再说一次，谢谢，只是别在哪个会议上跟我说你是在健身房听我的节目——那有点怪，让我有点发毛。总之这是疯狂的一年。年初大宗商品（commodities）走得有点疯，然后是金属的暴跌（melt down）。

turns.en: We had war, we had oil, we had the straight of hormones, everybody in their brother calling for $300 crude oil. I thought that Trader's going to work, didn't quite. We had an AI Doom piece on sub stack that actually moved the markets, got me all excited
turns.zh: 我们经历了战争，经历了石油，经历了霍尔木兹海峡（Strait of Hormuz），人人都在喊原油要涨到 300 美元。我本以为那笔交易能成，结果没太成。我们还看到 Substack 上一篇唱衰 AI 的文章真的搅动了市场，让我特别兴奋——

turns.en: that my AI equals recession theory was happening and it's real, might be actually today and this week. Anyway, through it all, some great conversations. I was scrolling back through the list of episodes, looking for some favorites. We'll start with somewhat of a weird one for all of you, maybe, but it was fun unless you know me.
turns.zh: 因为我那个“AI 等于衰退”（AI equals recession）的理论正在应验，它是真的，可能就在这周、就在此刻兑现。总之，一路走下来有很多很棒的对话。我翻回往期节目单，挑几个心头好。先从一个对你们来说可能有点怪的节目开始，但我觉得很有意思——除非你很了解我。

turns.en: Well, no, it was fun for me. I was excited to get Joel Gratz from Open Snow on the pod. He basically built a pod shop of a pod shop for powder days. The PMs are meteorologists and the returns are face shots. Not a lot of sharp ratio talk in there, but super fun and one of those examples where
turns.zh: 呃，不，对我来说很有意思。我很高兴请到了 OpenSnow 的 Joel Gratz 上节目。他基本上建了一家专门追粉雪日（powder days）的自营交易公司（prop shop）——基金经理（PM）是气象学家，收益就是迎面扑来的粉雪（face shots）。里头没多少夏普比率（Sharpe ratio）的讨论，但超级好玩，也是那种……

turns.en: a quant is out there in the real world doing real work. As for the ones you guys like, the solo six packs got some good reception again, so thanks for listening to those. We did two of them this year, spring and fall. Still a little terrifying to just talk to yourself with nobody there to bail me out.
turns.zh: ……一个量化人（quant）在现实世界里做着实实在在的工作的例子。至于你们喜欢的那些，“solo six pack”（单人六连发）系列又收获了不少好评，谢谢你们听。今年我们做了两期，春季和秋季各一期。一个人自说自话、没人帮我救场、

turns.en: Make me look smart, but we talked about Florida conferences, youth sports, AI again, and yeah, a ranking of men's room hand dryer. So go listen to that one if you didn't. Then of course we had a bunch of heavy hitters. We had Dr. Pat Welton who was Stanford oncologist, you know, like an actual cancer doctor who
turns.zh: 没人帮我显得聪明，还是有点吓人。但我们聊了佛罗里达的会议、青少年体育、又是 AI，还有——对——男厕干手器的排名。如果你没听过，去听听那期。然后当然我们还请了一堆重量级人物。有请了 Pat Welton 博士，他是 Stanford 的肿瘤科医生，你懂的，一位真正的癌症医生，

turns.en: traded pork bellies on the side and became one of the quiet legends of trend following. That was a fun one. Just last week, Cory Hoff seemed came on to talk return stacking and portable alpha and dish on his talk with Cliff Asnuss at their symposium. Speaking of return stacking, we also had Adam Butler on to talk AI and the profits with
turns.zh: 他业余炒猪腩期货（pork bellies），成了趋势跟踪（trend following）圈里一位低调的传奇。那期很有意思。就在上周，Corey Hoffstein 来聊了收益叠加（return stacking）和可迁移阿尔法（portable alpha），还爆料了他在研讨会上和 Cliff Asness 的对谈。说到收益叠加，我们还请了 Adam Butler 来聊 AI，以及那些带着……

turns.en: an F of doom. That was a fun one. And commodity trader Josh Blanchfield talking China's effect on why that aforementioned oil didn't go to 300 bucks. That was a good one. We got outside of the usual sandbox a bit too. We went nuclear with Trevor Holland, just in hoon on uranium and how that's finding its way into portfolios.
turns.zh: ……“末日 F”（F of doom）的收益。那期很有意思。还有大宗商品交易员 Josh Blanchfield 聊中国的影响——为什么前面提到的油价没涨到 300 美元。那期很不错。我们也有点跳出了老套的圈子。我们跟 Trevor Holland 一起“上了核电”（went nuclear），聊铀（uranium）以及它是怎么被纳入投资组合的。

turns.en: Super interesting and enlightening for me because I've been all in on the small modular reactor trade until they told me they're not that small like about the size of a parking lot at a school or whatnot. And one of at least my friends a bunch of feedback said, hey, we love the Ian Weiner talk
turns.zh: 对我来说超级有意思、也长见识，因为我本来 all in 押注小型模块化反应堆（small modular reactor，SMR）这个交易，直到他们告诉我这些反应堆没那么“小”——大概有一所学校停车场那么大之类的。而且至少我的一些朋友、还有一堆反馈都说，嘿，我们超爱 Ian Weiner 那期……

turns.en: on defense tech talking about drones and what they're doing in Ukraine and all the rest. That was pretty cool. A little scary. Fascinating them. So if you need some listening while you're traveling or hide from your in-laws or whatever, scroll back on your feed, hit play on one of those. Thank you. Enjoy it. All right. That's it.
turns.zh: ……讲国防科技（defense tech）、聊无人机以及它们在乌克兰等地做什么的那期。那期挺酷的，有点吓人，又很迷人。所以如果你在旅途中、或者想躲开姻亲之类的需要点东西听，就翻翻你的订阅列表，点开其中一期播放吧。谢谢，好好享受。好了，就是这样。

turns.en: Thanks again to our Sam for sponsoring all year. Thanks for Jeff Berger for producing. We'll give a shout out to Claire Bricksey who we don't usually thank here, but she's done a great job of organizing me and the guests all year. And as noted at the top, we'll be taking a little break. The whole team.
turns.zh: 再次感谢 RCM 一整年的赞助，感谢 Jeff Berger 担任制作。我们要特别致谢 Claire Bricksey——我们平时不太在这儿谢她——但她一整年把我和各位嘉宾都安排得妥妥帖帖。就像开头说的，我们要稍作休整，整个团队都是。

turns.en: I mean, we're still working every day, but taking a break from the pod, from Thanksgiving through hopefully be back first or second week of January, like going to recharge, drink a little egg nod, stop staring at the vix and crude oil charts, maybe, maybe not. But plans to be back soon with a killer slate of new guests for the new year.
turns.zh: 我是说，我们每天还是在上班，只是从播客上休息一下，从感恩节开始，希望能在一月第一或第二周回归。就是去充充电，喝点蛋奶酒（eggnog），别再盯着 VIX 和原油走势图看了——也许吧，也许做不到。但我们打算很快带着新一年超强阵容的新嘉宾回归。

turns.en: Thanks again. Happy new year. See you in 2027. Peace. You've been listening to The Derivedive. Links from this episode will be in the episode description of this channel. Follow us on Twitter at RCM Alts and visit our website to read our blog or subscribe to our newsletter at rcmalts.com.
turns.zh: 再次感谢。新年快乐。2027 年见。回见（Peace）。你刚才收听的是 The Derivative。本期节目的链接会放在本频道的节目简介里。在 Twitter 上关注我们 @RCMAlts，也欢迎访问我们的网站阅读博客，或在 rcmalts.com 订阅我们的简报。

turns.en: If you liked our show, introduce a friend and show them how to subscribe. And be sure to leave comments. We'd love to hear from you.
turns.zh: 如果你喜欢我们的节目，把它介绍给朋友，教他们怎么订阅。也记得留言，我们很想听到你的声音。
